about: What countdown's TfL notices provider stores for Kennington Underground Station and the postcode SE17 3LL: the status of the lines at the stop (v1:notices:tfl-lines:<stop id>), the disruptions there (v1:notices:tfl-stations:<stop id>) and the road disruptions near the postcode (v1:notices:tfl-roads:<place>), each under TfL's own names.
